title: 2015 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Nasser Al-Attiyah (Mini) and Marc Coma (KTM)
summary: The 2015 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 14 stage towns and bivouacs through Argentina, Chile, Bolivia. Winners — Cars: Nasser Al-Attiyah (Mini); Bikes: Marc Coma (KTM).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
